description: One day's all-day heart rate: resting, min and max, Garmin's 7-day resting average, and high / low heart-rate alerts (with the alert thresholds) if any fired. Set include_samples for heart rate through the day (averaged per 15 min), e.g. to see when it settled after a hard session. For resting HR over a range use garmin_get_daily_summaries.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in the user's time zone.

include_samples.description: Include heart rate averaged per 15 minutes. Default false.

name: garmin_get_heart_rate
title: Get Garmin heart rate
